formation_structure.artillery: Steward, returned Midnight and Lava remain deployed through observed clearance. Credit actual damage against enemy_1112_emppnt#0 separately from roadblocks and ground targets. Both medics retain their slots.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural recovery, four executed Fang grants, four executed Vanilla grants, and successful retreat refunds only.
economy.boundary: These balances require the survival, skill execution and successful departures producing them. A missing grant or refund invalidates the corresponding handoff; it is not an arithmetic defect.
economy.pricing: Static arithmetic uses catalog costs, Fang's supported self-cost reduction, and floor(actual deployment cost/2) retreat refunds. Redeployments require their actual base-plus-delta debit.

formation_structure.interceptions: Maintain separate upper central, lower central, upper outer and lower outer duties. The temporary lower column-3 position must be retired before the second civilian's passage; Beagle subsequently holds column 4.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel LEFT treats the upper formation. His enhancements are required for the distant western Lava and returned Midnight positions. Hibiscus RIGHT treats the lower formation. Healing ownership remains subject to the modeled missing-HP-ratio selector.
formation_structure.opening: Fang [3,4] and Vanilla [4,5] are diagonally separated. Initial combat and medical positions avoid M41's adjacent central trio. GALLUS leaves before Kroos occupies the neighboring ranged position. These changes remove the demonstrated shared-blast geometry; they do not establish an unknown artillery targeting radius.
formation_structure.slots: Peak occupancy is eight. Same-tile replacements follow retreat in the listed order. Melantha's first deployment temporarily assists Noir before the permanent lower outer handoff.

After that queue is dead, Beagle establishes column-4 interception.
Steward starts earlier artillery pressure under Ansel's enhancement.
Midnight returns after the full cooldown and catches upper central enemies released by Fang.
Spot supplies fresh upper outer durability.
Lava takes Durin's slot after lower western clearance; both medics remain.
Fresh Melantha assumes lower central clearance before the late armored and fast enemies.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator is a catalog member with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode=true. Every deployment uses the listed legal terrain, integer [row,col], and cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].

A retreat requires its listed replacement or an observed empty queue. Released enemies must be recaptured before passing the replacement; an upstream operator cannot recover enemies already behind it.

Track every actual locked point, projectile and blast disk. Opening separation prevents the demonstrated adjacent-trio overlap but does not prove individual survival. Same-frame ordering supplies no universal shell escape guarantee.

Melantha's assistance beside Noir and Durin's clearance beside Hibiscus are temporary exposure risks. A committed projectile threatening their required survival falsifies the relevant handoff; no hidden retreat controller is authorized.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Verify roadblock destruction, safe officer separation and both arrivals independently. Lower column-3 detention must be vacated before the second civilian approaches.

Measure effective artillery hits and remaining HP separately from ground and device damage. Keep the artillery formation through observed clearance; do not infer a kill from elapsed time or aggregate output.

Execute no deployment using an unobserved grant, a failed retreat refund, a death refund or an assumed free redeployment. A failed dependency rejects this fixed candidate rather than authorizing timeline repair.

Require remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths, and exactly two safe protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately and assess their lost duties.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Survive actual opening shells, kill the first central fast enemies, establish all four interceptions, and earn the first grants.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A killed generator or escaped first hostile rejects the opening and its dependent ledger.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Retain the released lower enemy, establish professional treatment, clear the old lower queue, and establish Beagle upstream.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An occupied old column-3 queue cannot be abandoned to an upstream replacement.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Measure Steward's artillery output, complete western roadblock work, return Midnight, and refresh upper outer durability.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Total damage, treatment events or available DP alone cannot validate these duties.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Keep the three artillery attackers and two medics, activate the charged return burst, and preserve lower clearance through Melantha's return.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An artillery escape, civilian death or lane overflow rejects the plan; no timed caster withdrawal is prescribed.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Clear remaining hostiles and pending projectiles, verify both civilian arrivals, and continue observation beyond this window if necessary.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: The last scheduled spawn or an empty-looking lane is insufficient for acceptance.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic grants expected at frames 570, 1320, 2070 and 2820 while alive and deployed. Credit only observed grants.
Four manual grants with ten active seconds and twenty recharge seconds between activations.
Hold initial readiness for artillery pressure. Each 25-second enhancement is followed by 35 inactive charging seconds. Verify expanded coverage of Lava and Midnight.
Lower treatment enhancement; each cycle includes twenty active and thirty recharge seconds.
Supported DEF enhancement; ordinary officer damage may already be at the minimum, so do not invent further reduction.
Return deployment resets SP to the supported initial amount. First arts activation follows forty new inactive seconds; subsequent recharge starts after the forty-second active duration.
Deployment SP permits readiness ten seconds after deployment; hold the first attack-speed enhancement for return fire. Credit single modeled hits without splash multiplication.
Return deployment resets SP. Enhancement beginning after forty charging seconds accelerates the late fast pair; later enhancement assists remaining armored clearance.
Use supported attack-SP enhanced hits; exclude probability talents and unsupported target-priority bonuses.
Ordinary modeled attacks only. Exclude unsupported resistance reduction, damage resistance, stat talents and guardian healing.

tactical_thesis: Revise M41's opening by separating the central interceptors, moving their support east, and replacing reciprocal melee damage with ranged assistance. Establish four interceptions, then use explicit retreat-and-replacement handoffs to return Midnight as an upper central blocker and third artillery attacker. Retain both professional medics throughout artillery clearance. Steward attacks earlier upper-right flight opportunities; Lava and charged Midnight cover the western return. Clearance depends on observed artillery damage, survival and competing targets, without a scheduled artillery withdrawal or asserted kill deadline.
